skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and content of business strategy for commercial enterprises in the context of integration.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Role and Purpose of Business Strategy
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the tasks and purposes, roles and positions of business strategies in business management.
Elaborate on the bases for selecting business strategies that are suitable for market trends: internal and external environment, potential opportunities, competitive capabilities.
Explain the impact of internal and external environmental factors on planning, selection, and implementation of business strategies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Relationship Between Potential Capabilities and Opportunities
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Explain the relationship between the potential capabilities of the enterprise, opportunities, and resources affecting planning, selection, and implementation of business strategies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Strategic Selection Based on Analysis Results
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Construct and present strategic options based on analysis results from industry environments, macro and international environments.
Practice planning, constructing, and implementing and adjusting business strategies, methods of operation suitable for changes in the market.
Apply business strategies to manage trading and service enterprises.
Demonstrate independence when working alone, show personal responsibility and responsibility towards the work group.
Formulate plans, coordinate, manage resources, assess and improve the efficiency of activities.
